detail: Full summary: lane 04 shipped a literal NUL byte in src/retrieval/select.ts (a cache-key join separator written as a raw 0x00 instead of the � escape), which makes the file binary to git. Caught by lane 02c's F4 regression test — the same defect 02c's own review found in v3-forward.ts. Runtime value unchanged by the fix.
